cells.gaps: Only Mahajanga is shown recording its taxpayers in a live system outside the capital, in February 2024; no share or total of communes is published.
cells.note: Mahajanga commune put its own SIGRL taxpayer and revenue software into use in February 2024 (MDG-010, MDG-011): a register live outside the capital, a count with no total, so 3. Antananarivo's market cards of October 2026 are an advance inside the twelve months.
